name: Deku
source:
The possessed doll used by the puppeteer(pacifier). She is merely a “tool,” possessing no will of her own and incapable of moving freely. Made from “Phantom Beast Essence,” a material possessed by yokai spirits.

Though she appears hard, she feels supple and soft to the touch, possessing an extremely high capacity for transmitting sexual pleasure.

Her appearance changes when a yokai possesses her. Because she is a semi-living entity, she secretes bodily fluids when pleasure accumulates.

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item9240/af-765?af_type=1&select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
